newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada says nothing U.S. can do to cap grain sales.
newsitem.headline: Canada says nothing U.S. can do to cap grain sales.

text.p: Agriculture Minister Ralph Goodale said on Tuesday that Canada would retaliate against any unilateral U.S. move to cap Canadian grain exports to the United States.
Goodale told Reuters there was "nothing that they can use on a unilateral basis that would not bring with it consequences flowing the other way."

Formerly the United States could have used Section 22 of the Agriculture Adjustment Act, but with new trade rules under the World Trade Organization, that provision has expired in its application to Canada, Goodale said.
